benchmark_type_evidence: we create a human-supervised benchmark, IndicXTREME, consisting of nine diverse NLU tasks covering 20 languages... Of the total 105 evaluation sets, summed across languages and tasks, 52 have been newly created as a part of this benchmark.
brief_description: IndicXTREME is a human-supervised NLU benchmark for Indic languages consisting of nine diverse tasks (five classification, two structure prediction, one QA, one retrieval) covering 20 languages from 4 language families, with 105 evaluation sets of which 52 are new contributions. It is designed to test zero-shot cross-lingual transfer of pretrained language models.
